## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--check-runner` (branch `phase/check-runner`). Code writes only under this worktree. Do not edit `.artifacts/`. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts`.

Territory: you own `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md` and commit-rule tests (`tests/test_task_commit.py` and/or `tests/test_execute_landing.py`). Concurrent wave-1 task `check-run-contract` owns the contract and enum-flip tests — do not edit those files.

After the change lands, commit on the phase branch (exclude `.artifacts`) before finishing so a pass can carry a real SHA. Run the task verify_command from the worktree.

Requirements:
R6: `execute-phase` requires a commit per task on the phase branch so a passing check-run can carry a real SHA.

Design invariants: A check-run records what happened; an assessment records what it means. Manual criteria never go through `check`. CLI is not a second store; it only shells to adaptive-artifacts. Parent session remains the authority that invokes the CLI and writes assessments.

Design assumptions: `payload_enum` enforcement already rejects illegal enum values at create time. Plugin packaging can expose `bin/se-workflow` similarly to `dashboard/bin/dashboard`. Subagents return evidence; the parent (or human) runs `se-workflow check` against the worktree.

Decision task-commit-evidence: execute-phase requires a commit per task so passing check-runs carry a SHA.
